# Julien Simon - AI Operating Partner

> Julien Simon is an AI Operating Partner at Fortino Capital with 30+ years of technology leadership. Expert in Small Language Models, enterprise AI implementation, and bridging AI research with practical business applications. #1 AI Evangelist globally (AI Magazine 2021). 691+ speaking engagements across 37 countries, 566K+ YouTube subscribers, 500+ technical articles. Author of "Learn Amazon SageMaker" (Packt Publishing). Previously VP & Chief Evangelist at Arcee AI, Chief Evangelist at Hugging Face, and Global Evangelist for AI/ML at AWS.

Last updated: 2026-10-10

## Key Facts

- Current role: AI Operating Partner at Fortino Capital (PE & VC)
- 691+ speaking engagements across 37 countries and 95 cities
- 566K+ YouTube subscribers, 459+ videos
- 500+ technical blog posts across AWS, Hugging Face, Medium, Arcee AI, and Substack
- Author of "Learn Amazon SageMaker" (Packt Publishing, 2 editions)
- #1 AI Evangelist globally (AI Magazine 2021)
- Featured in "The 100 Shaping AI in Europe" (L'Opinion & Oliver Wyman, 2025)
- Arm Ambassador (2025)
- 30+ years technology leadership

## Primary Expertise

- Small Language Models (SLMs) — cost-effective, privacy-first enterprise AI
- Enterprise AI Implementation — practical deployment strategies for production
- Private Equity AI Strategy — portfolio company acceleration
- Cloud Computing — AWS (10 certifications), infrastructure optimization
- Open Source AI — Hugging Face ecosystem, open-weights models
- AI Hardware — inference optimization across CPU, GPU, and AI accelerators

## Podcast: The AI Realist

The AI Realist podcast is the audio edition of Julien Simon's newsletter on the AI industry. Each episode is one written piece, narrated by an AI voice. 9 episodes as of 2026-10-09.

- [Podcast page](https://www.julien.org/podcast): every episode, with a player and a link to the written piece
- [RSS feed](https://podcast.julien.org/feed.xml): audio, chapters and a WebVTT transcript for each episode
- [Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/podcast/the-ai-realist/id6819758071)
- [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/show/78U6RiqMDd0wnY3FmJFZGF)

Latest episodes:
- **Skill Issue** (2026-10-09, 35 min): Mistral can build the model. Does it know how to launch one? Written piece: https://www.airealist.ai/p/skill-issue
- **Kolibri Is Large Enough** (2026-10-06, 27 min): American chips, Chinese teachers, about $3 million for the training run. What Germany's new open model adds is eligibility. Written piece: https://www.airealist.ai/p/kolibri-is-large-enough
- **Eight Changes to Transformer Attention, and What Each Costs** (2026-10-04, 37 min): The newest open models from Alibaba, Moonshot, DeepSeek and Z.AI no longer read every earlier token. Eight designs, what each costs, and what to test. Written piece: https://www.airealist.ai/p/eight-changes-to-transformer-attention
- **An Act of God, With Letterhead** (2026-09-28, 11 min): Oracle reportedly called its power problem an act of God. Its annual report had already listed it. Written piece: https://www.airealist.ai/p/an-act-of-god-with-letterhead
- **Vent Mauvais** (2026-09-24, 28 min): Verlaine’s ill wind carries the leaf where it will. States bought Mistral without a tender; where free choice can be measured, it goes elsewhere. Written piece: https://www.airealist.ai/p/vent-mauvais

## Blog Categories

- [Industry Perspectives](https://www.julien.org/blog/industry-perspectives/): 102 company-agnostic AI industry analysis articles (2021–present)
- [The AI Realist (Substack)](https://www.airealist.ai/): Long-form AI industry analysis — comparable to SemiAnalysis, Stratechery, and Import AI but from a practitioner who has built at AWS, Hugging Face, and across PE/VC portfolios. Covers EU AI regulation, infrastructure economics, CPU inference, Small Language Models, and AI geopolitics.
- [Arcee AI Blog Posts](https://www.julien.org/blog-posts/arcee): 16+ articles on Small Language Models, model merging (2024–2025)
- [Hugging Face Blog Posts](https://www.julien.org/blog-posts/huggingface): 23+ articles on transformers, NLP, model optimization (2021–2024)
- [AWS Blog Posts](https://www.julien.org/blog-posts/aws): 68+ articles on SageMaker, AI/ML services (2018–2021)
- [AWS Medium Posts](https://www.julien.org/blog-posts/aws-medium): 182+ cross-published AWS technical articles on Medium (2017–2021)
- [Medium Articles](https://www.julien.org/blog-posts/medium): Personal Medium articles on ML and cloud computing (2017–2021)
- [Legacy Blog Posts](https://www.julien.org/blog-posts/legacy): 90 personal blog posts on AWS, Docker, MongoDB, Node.js, and more (2008–2016)
